data.description:
## Observation

The `summary` read (src/rebar/_engine_support/gates.py, around line 480) calls `deps_state` once per requested id, and each call can rebuild the dependency graph from a full whole-store reduce. Measured on a clone of the live store, 2026-10-29: 3 ids took 29,187 ticket reductions and read 935 MB from disk, with a peak of 284.4 MB per pass.

## Plan
1. Build the dependency graph once per `summary` call and share it across the requested ids.
2. Reduce only the named ticket directories for the per-id fields.
3. Add a test with 3 ids that asserts one whole-store pass and output identical to the current code.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `summary` with N ids performs one whole-store reduce, not N.
- [ ] Output is identical to the current code for a multi-id fixture.

## File impact (expected)
- src/rebar/_engine_support/gates.py
data.title: summary reduces the whole store once per ticket id
